label: AI-OPERATED MATCHED SINGLE-WALL REMOVALS; SYNTHETIC DATA

protocol.studentPredictionScope: Condition selection only, not an outcome forecast.
protocol.sampling: Seeds base+1 onward. Check connectivity with separate text-grid BFS. Accept connected maps with at least one wall; preserve candidate seeds, distances, wall counts and rejection reasons.
protocol.wallRemoval: Blocked cells sorted row-major; remove index candidateSeed modulo blockedCount. Exactly one wall removed per accepted map. Deterministic selection, not uniform wall sampling.
protocol.priorRoute: Offline unlimited A* FIFO on each original connected map; verify its path and length against candidate BFS. Record acquisition calls/expansions separately from online policy work.
protocol.measurements: Same acquired prior route and same edited map per pair. Report usable routes, returned lengths over all 30 paired maps, planner expansions, optimization completions/budget failures, theoretical improvements from edited-map BFS, realized improvements within budget, retained fallbacks and potential missed improvements. No timing/energy measurement.
protocol.controls: Fixed endpoints (0,0) and (15,11), four-neighbor unit costs, only one wall changes to open, current position remains the original start for this batch. Not a progressed/moving robot.
protocol.attribution: Student selected the offered denser condition (.28 preset by AI), with no performance forecast. AI supplies sampling/edit/protocol, code, execution, validation and initial analysis.
protocol.scope: New 30-map condition was not generated when protocol/rule were frozen. Paired maps reused across policies, not independent per-policy maps. Seed change alone does not prove statistical independence. Density AND cohort differ from the .19 development study, so their contrast does not isolate a density effect.
protocol.stage: Acquire prior routes and an unguarded baseline before the separately frozen guarded comparison. Historical batch driver explicitly disables the later bound guard.

execution.provenance: Student selected the offered denser condition (.28 preset by AI), with no performance forecast. AI supplies sampling/edit/protocol, code, execution, validation and initial analysis.
